summary: First full backend + frontend test of Venturelyx MVP. Ran 27 pytest cases covering auth, onboarding, command center + growth score + AI next-best-action, operate leads/jobs/invoices, Stripe checkout (checkout_url returned), SEO scan + SSRF safeguard + keywords/competitors CRUD + audits, reviews list/add/respond/requests, AI streaming endpoints (seo/recommend, reviews/respond), settings update, and tenant scoping. All 27 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend Playwright flows verified: landing, register->onboarding->command, seeded owner login, sidebar navigation, lead create, invoice create + Pay button triggers Stripe checkout, SEO scan of example.com returns score 82, private URL http://127.0.0.1 rejected with clear error toast, AI 'Fix this for me' opens streaming dialog and streams a full recommendation (~2.3k chars), /app/build shows Coming Soon, settings save works, new tenant workspace shows 0 leads (tenant isolation confirmed).

ui_bugs.component: AI stream dialog (ScaleSEO Fix / Reviews Draft reply)
ui_bugs.issue: Streamed AI output appears to duplicate early tokens (e.g. rendered as 'GreatGreat news — news — this is one of the easiest fixes'). Looks like streamPost() is appending overlapping chunks or React state closure issue in lib/api.js streamPost consumer. The full text at end is coherent but the first ~30 chars are visibly duplicated.

action_items: Investigate AI streaming duplicate-token rendering in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js streamPost() (or its consumers in ScaleSEO.jsx / Reviews.jsx). Likely appending each SSE chunk to previous full accumulation instead of just delta, or race between setState calls.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_operate.update_job uses full JobInput (not partial) so any PUT without every field will overwrite with defaults (e.g. omitting value resets it to 0). Consider a JobUpdate model like LeadUpdate.
routes_payments checkout hard-codes success/cancel URLs off origin_url from client; consider validating origin_url against an allow-list to avoid open-redirect abuse.
auth.set_auth_cookie sets samesite='none' + secure=True; fine for cross-site preview domain but confirm production domain also served over HTTPS.

routes_seo.is_safe_url does DNS resolution but does not re-check IP after redirect; httpx follow_redirects=True could still fetch from a redirect that lands on a private IP. Consider disabling redirects or re-validating each hop's target.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_* users (qa_ui_*, qa_ob_*, TEST_flow_*, TEST_qa_*) and TEST_UI_Biz/TEST_UI_Biz2 tenants via API + UI. Test-created leads/jobs/invoices/reviews prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up in tests where possible; a few transient TEST_ business/tenant records remain in Mongo but are inert.
test_credentials: Seeded owner usasaranga@gmail.com / Venturelyx@2026 works. New user register+login+logout+re-login verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 27 backend tests pass; run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend industry field on onboarding is a Radix Select (not a plain input) — must click then click role=option. Invoice Pay button navigates in same tab (not new tab) — Stripe URL is returned by /api/payments/checkout (backend test confirms). AI stream duplicate-token bug in ai-output display is the only outstanding issue; the underlying /api/ai/* endpoints stream correctly (verified via backend tests).
rca_of_the_issue: Duplicate-token rendering in AI stream dialog is most likely a bug in the SSE/text-stream consumer (streamPost in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js). Either (a) the consumer is calling onChunk(full_text_so_far) but the component is appending it via setText(prev => prev + chunk), or (b) React 18 StrictMode double-invokes the reader in dev. Reproduction: login as owner, open ScaleSEO, scan example.com, click 'Fix this for me' on any failed check; dialog opens and the first several tokens appear doubled (e.g. 'GreatGreat news — news —'). Full output at the end is still readable.
